about: System One's additions to the influence graph, measured 2026-11-14. proposals: cause and consequence pairs Clef judged causal (p is its yes probability) that the curated links lack, each with Clairic's share of the consequence owed to the cause. inherited: Clairic's share of each consequence owed to all its causes together, the most it gives away. tools/credit-graph.ts turns these and the curated links into the strengths the index stores.
